cand.title: Congreso Centroamericano de Avicultura 2027
cand.excerpt: Evidence-backed event and hotel-market fit; accessibility treated conservatively.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two commercially relevant organizer contacts are verified, but neither is proven to control hotel contracts: Gregory Marte, ADA Executive Director and the October 2026 spokesperson for 2027 congress preparations; Pavel Concepción, ADA President in October 2026 reporting, elected for the 2025–2026 term. Gregory is the strongest operational routing contact; Pavel is a senior relationship/sponsorship route. Reconfirm Pavel’s title and each person’s 2027 responsibility before escalation.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming activity: 15–18 September 2027, Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, within the requested November 2026–May 2028 horizon. These are congress activity dates in the Gregory Marte interview description, not its 7 October 2026 publication date. The September 2025 host announcement links this edition to the regional Centroamericano y del Caribe series. No numbered 2027 edition designation is assumed.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: pursue a guestroom-led delegate/exhibitor group, a small sponsor meeting, or a pre/post-congress resort extension only if ADA confirms a usable booking route. Wyndham Alltra’s 620 rooms and all-inclusive format support a resort-stay proposition, but its approximately 380 m² meeting complex and approximately 300-person conference capacity do not fit the entire congress at historical scale. ANAVIP reports more than 2,000 participants and over 9,000 m² of exhibition space in 2025. The room inventory is not an estimate of congress demand. Venue-to-Uvero Alto transport feasibility remains unknown until the venue is named.
findings.venueCommitments: Punta Cana is confirmed at destination level. The 21 October 2026 Engormix announcement refers to confirmation of the sede but names no physical venue or hotel. No named 2027 host hotel, convention venue, signed lodging allocation or competing-hotel commitment was verified. Do not interpret the word sede alone as a hotel contract.
findings.historicalRotation: Documented sequence: XXV, San Pedro Sula, Honduras, 21–23 August 2018, Copantl convention center; XXVI, San Antonio de Belén, Costa Rica, 20–23 June 2023, Pedregal; XXVII, Panama, 10–12 September 2025, Panama Convention Center; then Punta Cana, 15–18 September 2027. This establishes a recurring cross-country congress, not an annual pattern or a guaranteed future return to Punta Cana. The 2023 dates include the opening on 20 June; scientific sessions began 21 June.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown/unconfirmed, not open. No verified 2027 lodging portal, group rate, room block, hotel RFP, appointed housing agency, PCO or DMC was identified. The October 2026 announcement says the official attendee/company platform would open soon; this does not establish whether it was live by 14 November 2026. ADA’s website provides an executive-director email and phone but is under construction. In 2023 the congress used four host hotels near Pedregal; that is historical accommodation evidence only, not a 2027 appointment or open inventory.
findings.organizationStructure: ADA is the Dominican host association, not a hotel or a demonstrated PCO/DMC. Fedavicac is the regional federation; ADA was elected to its presidency at the 2025 congress, when Dominican hosting for 2027 was announced. The evidence does not establish the precise legal contracting entity for 2027. Engormix is identified with dissemination/media support, not hotel procurement or congress ownership. No separate 2027 production or housing contractor was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The full congress is a poor sole-venue target for this hotel at historical scale. An integrated congress/hotel package elsewhere could limit off-site resort participation, but this is a commercial risk, not an evidenced 2027 restriction. No incumbent 2027 hotel, sold-out room block, overflow allocation, exclusivity clause or unsatisfied room demand was verified. Historical multi-hotel accommodation in Costa Rica does not prove Punta Cana overflow.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Gregory Marte through ADA’s published executive-director channel, direccionejecutiva@ada.org.do or +1 809-222-9344. Reference 15–18 September 2027 and request the named venue, congress secretariat/PCO, hotel procurement lead, contracted accommodation and whether any delegate/exhibitor allotments remain contestable. Ask for the official platform URL and a decision timetable. Offer a guestroom-led all-inclusive proposal only after venue, transport, stay requirements and access are confirmed; do not lead with a whole-congress venue bid. Use Pavel Concepción for senior introduction if needed, after reconfirming his title. No room-night forecast or overflow quote should be issued without published or organizer-confirmed demand.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The selected 2027 edition is confirmed and future-dated, but hotel access is unverified as of 14 November 2026. Do not label it booking-ready, open for hotel bids, closed, or committed elsewhere. Treat it as an organizer-qualification conversation pending the named venue, contracted lodging and procurement authority. The 2025 Panama event is expired and is used only as historical evidence.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: use the 2027 relationship to seek appropriately sized delegate/exhibitor accommodation or a separate resort extension if not already committed. For later editions, maintain ADA/Fedavicac relationships and ask about host-country rotation before pursuing a destination bid. No later Dominican edition, date, local room opportunity or recurring Punta Cana demand is verified.
